shared_elements: carved stone slab in low relief
horizontal band or register dividing the field
human or humanoid figure in profile
repeated small motifs in a row
justification: Both are pale tan stone surfaces worked in low relief with horizontally banded organisation and profile animal and human forms, and in each case figural motifs sit in a lower zone beneath a band of smaller repeated elements. The decisive difference is scale and density of carving: A has a few large, boldly modelled, almost sculptural creatures on an irregular monolithic block, while B is a rectilinear plaque covered in dense, uniform rows of tiny shallow signs, so any correspondence is generic rather than compositional.
